{{Quote|I am BNI-393, an LEP servant droid. My master called me Bunny."<br />"And where is your master?"<br />"He was killed when the Separatists took control of this ship."|[[BNI-393/Legends|BNI-393]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]]|<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''BNI-393's master''' stayed on board a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' with [[BNI-393/Legends|BNI-393]]. Around 20 BBY, the ''Renown'' was hijacked by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and all crewmembers save for droids, BNI-393's master included, were murdered.
